title: Meeting grilling skill
summary: Adds /grillo-meeting, the agent behind the live meeting panel: it picks tickets for the people present, follows Type and Listen modes, records answers with the session as source and keeps Listen talk as discussion; 24 new tests including the catalogue protocol table.

deferred.what: Two /grillo-meeting agents under one login (the host's second grilling agent) both pick the same lowest-numbered ticket, because the claim rule treats a ticket assigned to the member as theirs; both ask the same question and can record duplicate answers or close it twice
deferred.why: Telling 'claimed by my other agent' from 'sent to me' is a design choice that also depends on whether the meeting panel sends present: to a second agent
